sloka: स तस्य पततः खड्गं समाच्छिद्य महाकपिः।ननाद गिरिसङ्काशस्त्रासयन् सर्वनैर्ऋतान् ।। ६.७०.४४ ।।
transliteration: sa tasya patataḥ khaḍgaṁ samācchidya mahākapiḥ।nanāda girisaṅkāśastrāsayan sarvanairṛtān ।। 6.70.44 ।।

translations.english: Taking the sword from Trisira, as he was falling, the great Vanara who resembled a mountain roared, creating terror in all, surrounded there.
